tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL performance tuning, and data integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker, Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer, combining technical depth with business analysis and stakeholder management.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer (all genders) (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: Your opening for an SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer immediately caught my attention as an ideal match for my technical background. With over five years of specialized experience building, extending and supporting enterprise-grade e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring and REST APIs.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Java Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: Headless APIs & Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and designed PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Platform Operations & Cloud
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows, performing production troubleshooting and database query optimization.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Analysis
bullets.text: Bridged business and technical teams by analysing requirements, writing user stories and functional specifications, and translating them into robust SAP Commerce solutions in international environments.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start date 16 December 2026). I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my expertise can contribute to your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer (all genders) (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Die Ausschreibung als SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer hat mich sofort angesprochen, da sie perfekt zu meinem technischen Profil passt. Mit über fünf Jahren fundierter Praxiserfahrung in der Entwicklung, Erweiterung und Betreuung von Enterprise-E-Commerce-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich tiefgehende Expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring und REST-APIs mit.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Java
bullets.text: Konzeption und Implementierung von Backend- und Frontend-Funktionalitäten auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) mit Java und Spring für Produkt-, Katalog-, Preis- und Kundendatenmanagement nach Best Practices.

bullets.label: APIs & Integrationen
bullets.text: Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von OCC REST Web Services sowie Konzeption von PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines mittels Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub zur Synchronisation globaler E-Commerce-Kanäle.

bullets.label: Cloud & Betrieb
bullets.text: Ausführung von CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen und Release-Builds auf dem SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) im Rahmen agiler Workflows sowie Fehlerbehebung und Datenbank-Performance-Tuning.

bullets.label: Techno-Funktionale Analyse
bullets.text: Analyse von Geschäftsanforderungen, Erstellung von User Stories und funktionalen Spezifikationen sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Fach- und Technik-Teams.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, verfüge über einen unbeschränkten deutschen Aufenthaltstitel und befinde mich in einer Kündigungsfrist mit letztem Arbeitstag am 15.12.2026 (frühester Eintrittstermin 16.12.2026). Ich freue mich auf ein persönliches Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java expertise to your e-commerce initiatives, leveraging my hands-on background from Rockwell Automation and Shell to build robust, scalable platforms.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud, Java and REST API experience from enterprise projects to drive your e-commerce success.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi! I bring 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), Java & OCC REST API experience from Rockwell Automation & Shell. Valid German work permit, available from Dec 16. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application for the SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer position. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs and agile delivery. I hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 following my notice period. I look forward to discussing my profile with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
